his letter to Charles Ollier of 14 May 1820 (L ii 197) S. writes that Mary is transcribing
‘the little poems to be printed at the end of Prometheus’. While SP seems likely to have
been one of these, what Mary was transcribing may have been not the press-copy, but the
‘safe-keeping’ copy in Harvard Nbk 1 which she would have had to complete before S.’s
fair copy was posted; in that case, her date of March 1820 in that nbk would be the date of
composition. On the whole, SP was accurately printed in 1820, as comparison with Mary’s
transcription in Harvard Nbk 1 confirms. Only two corrections were made to the 1820
text in 1829, apparently from S.’s list of errata: see ii 15, iii 19 and notes. A further error in
1820 at iii 26 (see note) was not corrected until 1839; see also iii 66 and note. The Harvard
